description: TensorFeed's signed ruling on whether an AI benchmark is still a trustworthy capability signal or saturated, contaminated, or near ceiling so a high score should be down-weighted: a trust band (reliable, use_with_caution, saturated, contaminated, deprecated) and a 0-100 trust score per benchmark. Pass benchmark to narrow to one, or category to filter, or neither for the registry. tier='preview' is free (10 calls per day per IP), top verdict and bands only. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02) and adds the per-signal detail (ceiling proximity, frontier compression, contamination), a down-weight recommendation with an alternative benchmark, and an AFTA-signed receipt. Omit tier and you get the free preview, unless the call carries a payment or credits token (or uses the strict x402 transport), in which case it bills as full. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

benchmark.description: Benchmark registry id or name to narrow to one (e.g. "mmlu", "swe-bench"). Optional.

category.description: Category to filter the benchmarks (e.g. "coding", "reasoning"). Optional.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

tier.description: 'preview' (free, 10 calls per IP per day) or 'full' (1 credit; adds per-signal detail, recommendation, signed receipt). Omitted: preview, unless a payment or credits token is attached.

name: benchmark_trust_verdict
